title: Local thickness refinement of 8-layer ZnSe/ZnS stack with ±1.5 nm bounded optimizer
scientific_hypothesis: The iteration-14 optimum represents a local maximum in the thickness landscape; restricting optimization to ±1.5 nm variations around this point will allow the TMM solver to converge to the true discrete optimum without triggering quantization-induced score regression observed in prior rounds.
design_principle: Bounded local optimization preserves the verified interference structure while fine-tuning layer thicknesses within manufacturing-tolerable ranges. Small perturbations avoid large phase jumps that destabilize the spectral response.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | Ge substrate (8 finite layers, alternating sequence starting with ZnSe)
design_variables: Layer thicknesses (8 variables, bounded ±1.5 nm from iteration-14 candidate 1 values)
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band
Minimize mean transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band
Maintain smooth spectral transitions between bands
manufacturing_considerations: ±1.5 nm thickness tolerance represents tight but achievable deposition control
ZnSe and ZnS both compatible with thermal evaporation processes per evidence
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for dichroic filter design
Local optimization convergence theory for smooth parameter landscapes
TMM interference phase sensitivity to sub-wavelength thickness variations
expected_advantages: Avoids quantization jumps that caused score regression in iteration 14
Faster convergence due to reduced search space
known_risks: Local optimum may be suboptimal compared to global search
±1.5 nm bounds may be too restrictive if iteration-14 candidate is far from true optimum
Material dispersion data uncertainty in LWIR range
execution_request_english: Optimize an 8-layer planar dielectric stack on Ge substrate with Air incidence. Layer sequence: ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS (8 finite layers). Initialize thicknesses to [428.0013015883522, 72.27243184429491, 70.76705602667704, 51.57959322779923, 675.7509695845441, 72.33216138542882, 50.63714990161528, 547.4184886886561] nm. Apply bounded local optimizer (coordinate descent or truncated Newton) with thickness bounds ±1.5 nm from initialization values. Wavelength bands: 8000-11000 nm (high transmittance target), 3000-5000 nm (low transmittance target). Normal incidence, unpolarized light. Total layer count: 8. Material registry resolves ZnSe, ZnS, Ge optical constants. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Following feedback directive: initialize from iteration-14 candidate 1 exact thicknesses, switch to bounded local optimizer with ±1.5 nm variations to avoid quantization jumps that caused score regression from 0.2009 to 0.1983
